title: Marathon Split Pace Checkpoint Leaderboard
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:split
| stats avg(split_pace_min) as avg_value max(split_pace_min) as peak_value count as sessions by checkpoint
| sort avg_value
description: Ranks checkpoint values by average and peak split pace in minutes per kilometre, helping you see where marathon split pace performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which checkpoint contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `checkpoint` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of checkpoint, average split pace in minutes per kilometre, and peak split pace in minutes per kilometre.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which checkpoint areas give you the strongest marathon split pace results.
